source.title: Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (printed as the Ballymena Times), 8 June 1967, p. 14 ("Ballymena Rural District Council: notice of result of elections")
source.publisher: Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read from the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph's official notice of result, 8 June 1967, p. 14; the Galgorm figures were checked against the Belfast Telegraph's results table.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. The Galgorm division was the only contest; the other divisions were filled unopposed. The Longmore return, not legible in the Ballymena Observer's printing of the notice, is taken from the same notice in the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 14. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Citation corrected (w8-review, Nov 2026, from council-audit's reading of the masthead): the notice of result on BNA title 0005183, 8 June 1967, p. 14 is in the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, printed that year as the Ballymena Times, not the Ballymena Observer.
